authorization: No data generation, feature extraction, model execution, head fitting, confirmation access or additional sweep is authorized merely by this proposal file.
relationship_to_original: The original confirmation remains 0/6. Reusing all three frozen order-task encoders is deliberate conditioning, not three new training replications. Original source, weights, data, metrics and results remain unchanged.
one_mechanism: The effect of fitting a linear diagnostic head to mean noisy features rather than to the mean single-rollout binary cross entropy on the same cached noisy features.
why_limited: Jensen convexity explains why the two objectives differ but does not guarantee out-of-sample improvement after fitting. The native head already used a single-rollout BCE objective during joint training; this proposal therefore tests a diagnostic explanation, not a correction of the original native-head objective or upstream surrogate.
before_any_execution: Publish a separate immutable protocol, implementation/source/dependency hashes, exact numeric settings, input generator contract and output path manifest.
Generate no new train/development/confirmation identities until that freeze exists. Use the new namespace below and record SHA-derived stream seeds and dataset/trace hashes.
Retain all three encoders; select none based on new or old confirmation. The v2 implementation must read their weights without modifying them.
Verify cached final three-dimensional traces reproduce the original network's final affine score on fixed diagnostic inputs; this is an implementation check, not a parameter-selection step.
identity_keys: SHA256(namespace | role | encoder_seed | example_index | rollout_index); roles distinguish train/development/confirmation and input/trajectory randomness. Never use original study data or original named RNG streams.
task: order only, using the frozen task distribution and explicit one-segment transmission contract
features: Final second-layer 3-dimensional decaying count trace from each frozen encoder; no extra trajectory-history inputs, membrane readout, feature engineering, state aggregation at deployment or encoder adaptation.

budget.development_role: Descriptive diagnostics only; no early stopping, head selection, hyperparameter tuning or confirmation promotion.

shared_preprocessing.fit_scope: For each encoder, pool only its cached training examples and rollouts.
shared_preprocessing.location: Per-feature mean of pooled training traces.
shared_preprocessing.scale: max(per-feature population standard deviation of pooled training traces, 1e-8).

arms.name: mean_feature_head
arms.objective: mean_i BCE(y_i, w^T mean_r Z_ir + b) + (0.001/2)*||w||_2^2

arms.name: single_rollout_risk_head
arms.objective: mean_i mean_r BCE(y_i, w^T Z_ir + b) + (0.001/2)*||w||_2^2

optimizer_proposal.method: float64 deterministic L-BFGS-B with analytic gradients
optimizer_proposal.regularization: Same coefficient 0.001 on three standardized-feature weights; intercept unpenalized.
optimizer_proposal.stable_loss: logaddexp(0,score) - label*score; no prediction clipping changes to the target risk.
optimizer_proposal.numerical_acceptance: Each final objective and gradient is finite and infinity-norm gradient <= 1e-6. If an arm fails, retain the failure and mark the mechanistic comparison numerically incomplete; do not increase the cap after seeing confirmation.
optimizer_proposal.version_rule: Exact Python/NumPy/SciPy versions and BLAS thread count must be fixed in the execution protocol before any feature generation. This proposal selects no versions or fitted parameters.

confirmation.primary_estimand: Expected single-rollout BCE of the mean-feature-fitted head minus that of the risk-fitted head, averaged equally across the three frozen encoders.
confirmation.paired_observations: Both heads are evaluated on identical cached confirmation traces and labels. Average 32 losses within an example before inference; do not treat the 32 rollouts as independent examples.
confirmation.bootstrap: 4000 registered replicas: sample three encoder indices with replacement, then paired complete examples within each selected encoder. Preserve all within-example repeats.
confirmation.single_gate: Empirical lower endpoint exceeds 0.02 and all three encoder-specific means are positive.
confirmation.coverage_limit: An empirical resampling summary conditional on three already-selected frozen encoders; not a population coverage guarantee, new training-seed robustness result or universal superiority statement.
confirmation.descriptive_only: The original native head may be evaluated on the same fresh traces as a predeclared reference, with no additional gate or post-hoc selection.

cost_accounting: Cache generation is shared by both arms; report its measured wall time/event counts separately from optimizer iterations and head fitting time. Deployed prediction uses one trajectory. Confirmation repeats estimate expected risk; they are not an ensemble policy.
claims_allowed_if_passed: For these three frozen order-task representations and this bounded fresh-data experiment, fitting the diagnostic head to single-rollout risk improved that risk relative to fitting to mean features by the proposed margin.
claims_not_allowed: The original native network was repaired or original confirmation gates now pass.
The upstream straight-through estimator is unbiased or the encoder learned optimally.
The method beats LIF/RNN across tasks, is compute-optimal, or has optimal coupled-neuron firing boundaries.
finite_stop_rule: Run the frozen design once. Report pass, negative result or numerical incompleteness with all six heads and all three encoders. Do not add repeats, choose a subset of encoders, lower the margin, switch to ensemble loss or start a width/optimizer sweep to obtain a pass. Any subsequent study is a distinct research question with fresh preregistration.
